note: One entry per BOX, keyed by device_id (all three report sn box_collection_controller_000001; the id is the only thing that tells them apart, and the v4.1 firmware renumbered every BOX on 10-31, so a renumbering must be redone here). role: handheld (hand = the operator's hand it is held in) or fr3_gripper (which arm it is on lives in tools/fr3/fr3_arms.json, not here). six_d_payload: what the 6D sensor carries, one record per end-effector configuration, the latest valid_from_unix not after a sample applies; K (6x3, N and N*m per g of IMU acc_g) comes from `python -m tools.thor.gmsl2.box_six_d fit` on a free-air rotation (6 faces, 2-3 s each). Mounting or removing anything on the payload side of the sensor (gripper, brackets, cube) starts a new record: add one with K null and the time of the change, so the old fit is not applied to the new load, and fit again. See tools/thor/gmsl2/box_six_d.py for why the SDK's no_gravity is not used.
